_comment: Hardware wiring for the --driver=stand composite driver.
Copy config/hardware.example.json here and edit for your stand.
This is deliberately NOT part of stand.json: that file is edited through
the Config page in the browser and rewritten on every save. Wiring should
not be reachable from a browser, and should not churn when someone
8 TC (two NI-9211s), 11 PANDA DC current-sense channels.
channelMap ties a hardware channel to a sensor id in stand.json.
DAQ channel indices RESTART AT 0 on every card, so the key carries the
card: pt0 is NI-9208 ai0, lc0 is NI-9237 ai0, tc0 is the first 9211 ai0.
TC channels run across both 9211 modules: tc0-tc3 are slot 3, tc4-tc7
are slot 4. A channel with metadata but no channelMap entry is acquired
and logged, but never becomes a sensor reading.

panda._ptInputMode: Current firmware sends VOLTS across the shunt on 'p' lines, not mA. Set to 'ma' only if your firmware pre-converts.
panda._dcThresholdA: A solenoid channel counts as energized above this current, in amps.
panda._armHardware: Mirror GC-4's ARM state to the board's own arm latch ('a'/'r').
panda._channelMap: The PANDA reports its own sensors too. Map any you want to surface; these overwrite the DAQ's value for the same sensor id, so leave it empty unless the PANDA is the authority for that channel.
_dcChannels: Solenoid / pushbutton current sense from the board's 's' lines, in
AMPS. Diagnostics, not process values: they confirm a coil actually
drew current, so they render as small text on the actuator they watch.
id       the PANDA channel the board ACTUATES (S<n>) -- NOT the same
as the key: per sensor_config.xlsx the purges (DC7/DC8) sit
at s-line positions 4/5 while the runlines (DC5/DC6) sit at
6/7, so report order and actuation order are swapped.
pidTag   the tag on Draco V4.00 (S1..S5, PB1..PB6)
valve    the stand.json valve this channel senses
sensed   OPTIONAL. false = this position has no working current sense
(unpopulated input, or one pinned at a fixed offset).
The valve then shows NO current row at all, instead of a
number that is not a measurement. Above dcThresholdA such
a number reads as an ENERGIZED valve that is not, which is
Set this only after confirming with a meter: if the
current is real, suppressing it hides a live coil.
Source: sensor_config.xlsx DC_Solenoids. Position 8 is unpopulated.
panda._dcOrder: Wire position -> logical index, for firmware whose 's' line order does not match channel order. This board reports in order, so it is null. Re-verify against the harness before setting it.

1.name: Fuel BB
1._note: workbook short_name says s1 for both BB rows; Draco V4.00 shows S2 on the fuel leg

_valveDevice: Optional per-valve routing, valveId -> device key. Defaults to the first actuation-capable device (the PANDA).
